as_told.title: Condon's AIP interview on needing a clearance

plain: This story is about how the physicist Edward Condon came to lead a UFO study for the US Air Force in 1966. The podcast host Jesse Michels says that a fellow scientist, Lewis Branscomb, told Condon something like "maybe it's time you get your clearance back," meaning his permission to see secret material. Michels says the exchange comes from an interview Condon gave to the American Institute of Physics, a scientific body that records interviews with scientists. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, tells it too on the same podcast, citing the same interview. In his version, Branscomb told Condon that the Air Force needed someone to head up its UFO study, which was based at the University of Colorado. Michels also mentions the astronomer Donald Menzel in this context. It is told because, if the account is right, the man picked to judge UFOs was steered into the job with a nudge back into the world of secrets.
